mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.signInPrompt: Sign in to set up or complete two-step verification.

mfa.completed: Verification completed. You can now perform administrator actions.

recovery.codeLostHelp: For security, the link's code is only kept in this tab. If you reload the page or open the link in another tab or device, open the link from the email again or paste the full link here.

readiness.notice_pending: Waiting for confirmation that the approval notice was delivered…

recovery.forbiddenTeam: This feature is only for team members.
recovery.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
recovery.confirmWrong: Couldn't confirm. Check your password and try again.

recovery.strayLink: You opened a verification link, but this account has no request in progress. If the link is for another account, switch accounts: the code is kept while you sign in.
recovery.denied: An administrator rejected your previous request.
recovery.deniedWithReason: An administrator rejected your previous request: {reason}
recovery.requestIntro: If you lost access to your authenticator app, you can ask for it to be reset. We'll send you an email to verify it and another administrator will have to approve it. Your role doesn't change.
recovery.noApprover: There is no other administrator or Developer who can approve it. Contact the project owner, who carries out the recovery from the Supabase controls.
recovery.requestSent: We sent you an email to verify the request.
recovery.pendingIntro: We sent you an email with a link. Open it with this session signed in, or paste the link's code here (what follows «#c=»).
recovery.emailVerified: Email verified. Approval from an administrator is still needed.
recovery.resent: We sent you a new email.
recovery.otherAccountHelp: Did you open the link with another account? Switch accounts.
recovery.waitingApproval: Email verified. Waiting for an administrator's approval. No authenticator has been removed yet.
recovery.executionIncomplete: The invalidation didn't finish. You can try again.
recovery.confirmExecute: This removes your current authenticator. You'll have to set up a new one.
recovery.afterInvalidated: Your previous authenticator was invalidated. Set up a new one: open two-step verification in a new tab, scan the code and verify it. This page detects it on its own and completes the recovery; you don't need to press anything else. If your session closed, sign in again.
recovery.notDetected: No new verified authenticator is detected in this session yet.
recovery.confirmPasswordIntro: For security, confirm your current password to continue. You don't need your authenticator.

becomeDev.heading: Become a Developer
becomeDev.intro: With this change your account will stop being Admin and become Developer: you'll have access to the technical tools, but no longer to the administration ones. To be an Admin again you'll need another Admin to restore you. This is a change to your own account; it can't be done to another person.

blocked.recovery_in_progress: An authenticator recovery is in progress for an Admin. You'll be able to make this change when it finishes.
